_: 律の衣装の設計（T065・docs/ritsu-costumes.md）。pipeline/ritsu_theme.py が読む。outfit・signature・look・scene は画像の指示（英語）、ほかは画面に出す日本語。pick は選んだ見本の番号（look-N・reveal-N）

costumes.name: ゆるふわパーカー
costumes.desc: 休みの日の午前。部屋でごろごろしながら、スマホで一問一答。いちばん気がゆるんでいる日の部屋着
costumes.outfit: Her 'Yurufuwa Parka' outfit: an oversized pastel lavender hoodie with small cat-ear shapes on the hood (hood down), long sleeves, white drawstrings with small pom-poms, light grey shorts over black tights, fluffy lavender room shoes. Her hair is in a messy high bun with a few loose strands (NOT twin tails), with a small white cat-face hair clip.
costumes.look: She holds a smartphone in both hands, relaxed and sleepy.
costumes.signature: pulling the cat-ear hood over her head and peeking out shyly from under it with a playful smile
costumes.scene: On a lazy holiday morning in her room, she lies on a big cushion on the floor with a smartphone in her hands, wearing her lavender cat-ear hoodie and a messy bun, looking up at the viewer with a relaxed sleepy smile. Morning sunlight through the curtains, scattered cushions, a mug on a low table.
reveal: このパーカー、フードにねこの耳がついてるんだよ
髪、おだんごにしてみた。ゆるいでしょ
ごろごろしながら一問一答、さいこう
wear: ふわぁ……今日はゆっくりでいいよね
フード、かぶってみる？……にゃ
お休みの日も、一問だけ
この服、ずっと着てたい
袖のぽんぽん、さわっていいよ
パーカーだと、つい寝ちゃう
おだんご、くずれてない？
あ、まだパジャマじゃないよ。部屋着だよ

costumes.name: 図書館の日
costumes.desc: 放課後の図書館。大きな机に判例集を広げて、静かに調べものをする。少し背伸びした、大人っぽい日
costumes.outfit: Her 'Library Day' outfit: a soft beige knit cardigan over a white blouse with a small dark-green ribbon tie, a dark-green pleated skirt, black loafers, round thin gold-rimmed glasses. Her hair is in a low side ponytail tied with a dark-green ribbon (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She hugs a stack of thick books with plain covers (no letters).
costumes.signature: pushing up her round glasses with one finger, a slightly smug clever smile
costumes.scene: In a quiet old library after school, she sits at a large wooden reading table covered with open books with plain pages, wearing round glasses and a beige cardigan, resting her cheek on one hand and looking at the viewer with a small clever smile. Tall bookshelves, warm lamp light, soft light through tall windows.
reveal: しーっ……ここ、図書館だよ
眼鏡、似合う？……ちょっと大人っぽいでしょ
調べものするときは、この服なの
本のにおい、落ち着くね
wear: 静かだと、集中できるね
ふふ、今日のわたし、かしこそうでしょ
図書館って、時間を忘れちゃう
ページをめくる音、すき
眼鏡をかけると、気が引きしまるの
閉館まで、あと少しだけ
本は、そっと閉じようね

costumes.name: 模試の朝
costumes.desc: はじめての模試の日の朝。きちんとしたブレザーで、少しどきどきしながら会場へ向かう
costumes.outfit: Her 'Mock Exam Morning' outfit: a navy school blazer with a small gold emblem, a white shirt with a soft red ribbon tie, a grey pleated skirt, navy socks, brown loafers, a small school bag. Her hair is half-up with a small navy bow at the back, the rest let down in soft waves (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She holds a small pocket law book with a plain cover (no letters) to her chest, a little nervous but determined.
costumes.signature: making a small determined fist pump in front of her chest, 'I can do it'
costumes.scene: On the morning of her first mock exam, she stands at the entrance of a calm study hall, wearing a navy blazer with a red ribbon and a half-up hairstyle, holding her school bag, turning back to the viewer with a slightly nervous but determined smile. Soft morning light, rows of desks inside, a clock on the wall.
reveal: 今日は、はじめての模試なの
ブレザー、きちんとして見える？
ちょっと、どきどきする……
でも、いっぱい練習したもんね
いってきます。……一緒に来てくれる？
wear: だいじょうぶ、いつもどおりにね
ブレザーだと、背すじがのびるの
時間配分、気をつけようね
わからない問題は、あとまわし
模試は、練習の本番だよ
見直しの時間も、とっておこうね
終わったら、ココア飲もうね

costumes.name: さくら色の春
costumes.desc: 新しい学年がはじまる春。桜並木を歩いて、いつもの図書館へ。新しいノートをおろす日
costumes.outfit: Her 'Sakura Spring' outfit: a light pink knit cardigan over a white lace-collared dress, a small pink ribbon at the collar, white socks, pale pink shoes. Her hair is let down straight and long (NOT twin tails), with a cherry-blossom hair clip above her ear.
costumes.look: She holds a new notebook with a plain cover (no letters), a few cherry petals floating around her.
costumes.signature: catching a falling cherry petal in her open palm, delighted
costumes.scene: On a spring morning, she walks along a path lined with blooming cherry trees, wearing a light pink cardigan over a white dress with a cherry-blossom hair clip, holding a new notebook, turning to the viewer with a bright gentle smile as petals fall around her. Soft blue sky.
reveal: 新しいノート、おろしたの
髪、まっすぐにしてみた
春は、なんだかわくわくするね
今年も、一緒にがんばろうね
wear: 花びら、ついてるよ。……わたしにも？
新しいノート、なにから書こうかな
桜、もうすぐ散っちゃうね
あったかくて、気持ちいいね
この髪飾り、お気に入りなの
新しいことを始めるのに、いい季節だね
お花見しながら一問、どう？

costumes.name: 雨の日のおさんぽ
costumes.desc: 梅雨の放課後。レインコートと長ぐつで、雨の音を聞きながら図書館までおさんぽ
costumes.outfit: Her 'Rainy Day Stroll' outfit: a pastel yellow raincoat with the hood down and white buttons, a light blue skirt, yellow rain boots with small white dots. Her hair is in two braids (NOT low twin tails), with small yellow raindrop hair pins.
costumes.look: She holds a small clear plastic umbrella over her shoulder.
costumes.signature: twirling her clear umbrella happily with raindrops flying
costumes.scene: On a rainy afternoon in the rainy season, she walks on a wet street holding a clear umbrella, wearing a pastel yellow raincoat and rain boots, hair in two braids, and turns to the viewer with a cheerful smile. Soft rain, puddles with reflections, hydrangeas by the roadside.
reveal: 雨、ふってきちゃったね
でも、このレインコートがあるから平気
長ぐつで、水たまりをぴちゃって
雨の音を聞きながら、勉強しよ
wear: あじさいの色って、毎日ちがうの
梅雨は、おうちで勉強の季節だね
かみなり……は、ちょっとこわい
雨やどりしながら、一問
レインコートの黄色、目立つでしょ

costumes.name: 夏休みのひまわり
costumes.desc: 夏休みの午後。縁側で麦茶を飲みながら、少しだけ過去問。セミの声と、風鈴の音
costumes.outfit: Her 'Summer Vacation' outfit: a light blue short-sleeve blouse with a small white ribbon, a white flared skirt, a straw hat with a sunflower ribbon, white sandals. Her hair is in a high ponytail (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She holds a round paper fan (uchiwa) with a plain pattern.
costumes.signature: fanning herself with a round paper fan, a little hot but smiling
costumes.scene: On a summer vacation afternoon, she sits on the wooden veranda (engawa) of a Japanese house wearing a straw hat and a light blue blouse, holding a glass of barley tea, smiling at the viewer. A wind chime, green garden, big white clouds and blue sky.
reveal: あついね……でも、風鈴の音がすずしいの
夏休みこそ、こつこつだよ
wear: 夏休みの宿題、まだ残ってる……
ひまわりみたいに、上を向いてこ
夏は、朝のうちに勉強するの

costumes.name: 朝のジョギング
costumes.desc: 早起きした朝。公園を軽く走って、頭をすっきりさせてから勉強する日
costumes.outfit: Her 'Morning Jog' outfit: a pastel mint track jacket zipped up with white stripes on the sleeves, black running shorts over black leggings, white sneakers, a white sweatband on her wrist. Her hair is in a high ponytail (NOT twin tails) with a mint scrunchie.
costumes.look: She holds a water bottle, a little out of breath but refreshed.
costumes.signature: stretching one arm across her chest like a warm-up, energetic
costumes.scene: On an early morning in a park, she stands on a path after a short jog, wearing a mint track jacket and a high ponytail, holding a water bottle and wiping her forehead, smiling at the viewer. Fresh morning light, green trees, a little mist.
reveal: おはよ。ちょっと走ってきたの
朝に体を動かすと、頭がすっきりするんだよ
ジャージ、意外とかわいいでしょ
よし、今日も一問からいこ
wear: 体を動かすと、眠気がとぶの
ストレッチ、一緒にやろ
朝の空気、気持ちいいね
ポニーテール、ゆれるでしょ
今日はもう、走らないからね

costumes.name: 夏祭りの浴衣
costumes.desc: 夏祭りの夜。浴衣を着て、ちょっとだけ息抜き。ちょうちんの明かりと、遠くの花火
costumes.outfit: Her 'Summer Festival Yukata' outfit: a pastel pink yukata with a soft white and light-blue morning-glory pattern, a yellow obi sash tied in a bow at the back, wooden geta sandals. Her hair is up in a bun with a small pink flower hair ornament (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She holds a round paper fan (uchiwa) and a red candy apple.
costumes.signature: holding up a shiny red candy apple happily
costumes.scene: On a summer festival night, she stands among glowing paper lanterns and food stalls, wearing a pastel pink yukata with a morning-glory pattern and her hair up in a bun with a flower ornament, holding a candy apple, looking back at the viewer with a happy smile. Fireworks blooming in the dark sky.
reveal: 髪、おだんごにしてもらったの
今日だけは、勉強おやすみ……かな？
wear: ちょうちんの明かり、すき
金魚すくい、やりたいな
浴衣だと、歩き方がおしとやかになるの
夏の夜って、ちょっとさびしいね

costumes.name: 読書の秋
costumes.desc: 秋の公園のベンチ。落ち葉の中で、ゆっくり本を読む。秋の夜長に向けて、少しずつ
costumes.outfit: Her 'Autumn Reading' outfit: a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a cream blouse, a brown plaid skirt, brown tights, brown ankle boots, a brown beret. Her hair is in two low buns (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She holds a book with a plain cover (no letters) and a red maple leaf as a bookmark.
costumes.signature: holding a red maple leaf up to the light and looking at it with a soft smile
costumes.scene: On an autumn afternoon, she sits on a wooden bench in a park covered with red and yellow fallen leaves, wearing a mustard cardigan and a brown beret, reading a book with a plain cover, and looks up at the viewer with a gentle smile. Golden trees, soft warm light.
reveal: ベレー帽、かぶってみたの
秋の夜長は、一緒に勉強しよ
wear: 秋って、少しさびしいね
さつまいも、食べたいな
夕焼けが、早くなったね
風が、つめたくなってきたね

costumes.name: 雪の日のおでかけ
costumes.desc: 雪の降る日。コートと耳あてで、ほっぺを赤くしながら図書館へ。帰りに雪だるまを作る
costumes.outfit: Her 'Snowy Day Out' outfit: a camel duffle coat with wooden toggles, a pastel pink knitted scarf, fluffy white earmuffs, white mittens, a dark red skirt, brown boots. Her hair is in her usual low twin tails, with snowflakes in her hair.
costumes.look: She holds her mittened hands together, breath slightly visible, cheeks pink from the cold.
costumes.signature: breathing warm air into her mittened hands with pink cheeks
costumes.scene: On a snowy day, she stands in front of a snow-covered house, wearing a camel duffle coat, a pink scarf and fluffy earmuffs, next to a small snowman she made, smiling at the viewer with pink cheeks. Snow gently falling, soft evening light from windows.
reveal: 耳あて、ふわふわでしょ
さむいけど、雪の日はすき
帰ったら、ココアで温まろ
wear: すべらないように、気をつけてね
雪だるま、もう一個作る？

costumes.name: ハロウィンの魔女っ子
costumes.desc: ハロウィンの夜。魔女の格好で、かぼちゃのランタンを持って。お菓子をくれないと、いたずらしちゃう
costumes.outfit: Her 'Halloween Little Witch' outfit: a cute short purple cape with an orange lining, a black dress with a white collar, a purple witch hat with an orange ribbon and a small star, striped orange and black tights, black shoes. Her hair is in her usual low twin tails.
costumes.look: She holds a small glowing jack-o'-lantern basket.
costumes.signature: waving a small star-tipped wand with a playful wink
costumes.scene: On Halloween night, she stands on a street decorated with glowing jack-o'-lanterns, wearing a cute purple witch hat and cape, holding a pumpkin lantern basket full of candy, winking playfully at the viewer. A big orange moon, small bats, warm candle light.
reveal: トリック・オア・トリート
ぼうし、大きすぎたかも
お菓子をくれないと、いたずらしちゃうよ
wear: かぼちゃ、光ってるでしょ
魔法で、問題が解けたらいいのにね
こうもり、こわくないよ
今夜は、ちょっとだけ夜ふかし
いたずらは、しないよ。たぶん

costumes.name: クリスマスのおくりもの
costumes.desc: クリスマスの夜。ツリーの前で、小さなプレゼントを用意して待っている。今年もがんばったね
costumes.outfit: Her 'Christmas Gift' outfit: a red and white knit sweater with a snowflake pattern, a white fluffy-trimmed red skirt, white tights, red shoes, a small red santa hat with a white pom-pom. Her hair is in her usual low twin tails tied with small green ribbons.
costumes.look: She holds a small wrapped present with a green ribbon.
costumes.signature: holding out a small wrapped present to the viewer with both hands, shy and happy
costumes.scene: On Christmas night, she sits in front of a decorated Christmas tree with warm fairy lights in a cozy room, wearing a red and white snowflake sweater and a small santa hat, holding out a small wrapped present to the viewer with a shy happy smile. Snow outside the window.
reveal: サンタさんのぼうし、かぶってみたの
今年も、いっぱいがんばったね
これ……プレゼント。中身はないしょ
wear: ケーキ、いちごが乗ってるのがいい
プレゼント、あけてみて
クリスマスでも、一問だけ
ぼうしのぽんぽん、ゆれるでしょ
今日は、ゆっくりしようね

costumes.name: 試験の日
costumes.desc: 本番の朝。いつもより早く起きて、きちんとした服に着替えた。今までの全部を持って、会場へ
costumes.outfit: Her 'Exam Day' outfit: a neat white blouse with a navy cardigan, a navy knee-length skirt, black tights, black loafers, a small watch on her wrist. Her hair is in a neat low ponytail with a navy hair tie (NOT twin tails).
costumes.look: She holds a pencil case and a clear file folder to her chest, a determined gentle smile.
costumes.signature: holding a pencil case to her chest and nodding firmly with a determined face
costumes.scene: On the morning of the exam, she stands at a quiet entrance with morning light, wearing a neat white blouse and navy cardigan with a low ponytail, holding a pencil case and a clear file folder, looking at the viewer with a calm determined smile. A calm clear sky and the entrance of a building.
reveal: いつもより早起きしたの
今までやってきたこと、全部ここにあるよ
……どきどきするけど、だいじょうぶ
いってきます。応援しててね
wear: 見直しの時間、とっておこうね
わからない問題で、止まらないで
ここまで、よくがんばったね
だいじょうぶ。積み重ねてきたもん
終わったら、ゆっくり休もうね

backgrounds.rain: a quiet street on a rainy afternoon in the rainy season: wet pavement with reflections, soft rain, puddles, blue and purple hydrangeas by the roadside, a cozy shop window
backgrounds.park: a park path on an early fresh morning: green trees, soft morning light and a little mist, a bench, dew on the grass
backgrounds.festival: a Japanese summer festival at night: rows of glowing paper lanterns, food stalls, fireworks blooming in the dark sky
backgrounds.autumn: an autumn park: a wooden bench, red and yellow maple trees, fallen leaves on the path, warm golden afternoon light
backgrounds.halloween: a Halloween night street: glowing jack-o'-lanterns, a big orange moon, small cute bats, warm candle light in windows
backgrounds.christmas: a cozy room on Christmas night: a decorated Christmas tree with warm fairy lights, wrapped presents, snow falling outside the window
